summary_en: This work improves 3-D functional ultrasound localization microscopy by incorporating microbubble backscattering intensity alongside localization counts in a Poisson-statistical framework. summary_en: The paper introduces a track-based fULM estimator that aggregates complete microbubble trajectories instead of relying only on sparse localization centroids. In awake mice, the method identifies activated brain regions in fewer than five stimulation cycles and reduces the reported acquisition requirement by more than half relative to conventional fULM.
